body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: In a pioneering administrative initiative aimed at enhancing transparency and accountability in public governance, Health, Medical, and Family Welfare Minister Satya Kumar Yadav is introducing an AI-powered portal—MMATRIX—to monitor the progress of public petitions and official review decisions in real time.
